sections.text: Released date: 24.06.2026 on the celebration of the festival of Gaṅgā-daśaharā and Śrī Gaṅgā pūjā, the appearance of Śrīmatī Gaṅgāmātā Gosvāminī and the disappearance of Śrīla Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa Prabhu. For the benefit of all.
